text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Walking through the academy halls one
lunchtime, I happen to spot a
familiar face
on the other side of a classroom window.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The seven of hearts should be over here
on the right...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello Trainer. I'm playing pairs.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've nearly flipped all the cards, and with
this I should... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Aw, I've forgotten where everything is
now...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, you don't have to apologize. I just
need to concentrate harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In silence, Suzuka lays the cards face down
once again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: All right. This time for sure.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Y-yes, that's right. It's pretty fun,
you know, solo pairs.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've imposed a limit on the number of
mistakes I can make, so it's still

challenging.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she certainly possesses the mentality
to strictly adhere to that
limit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm here now, however, I propose a
two-player game.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You want... to play? Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry. You took me a bit by surprise...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... okay. Let's give it a shot. May the
sharpest thinker win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We begin our game of double pairs.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Aw, that wasn't it. Okay, your turn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are only a few cards left on the
desk. I hit a lucky streak,
snatching up
pairs one after another.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Those too? No! I had my eyes on
them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite Suzuka's protests, I continue to
flip over pair after pair.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Aw, you keep taking the cards that I'm
after...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
My favorite part is when I can flip over a
bunch of cards at the end of
a game
without anyone getting in the way...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but please don't worry about that. I
agreed to your invitation to
play together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears I was a bit of a distraction after
all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is something wrong? I'm going to
lay the cards out again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and I won't let you distract me this
time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue playing until Silence Suzuka
has a good number of wins
to her name.
